title: How to Start an LLC in Ohio: A Step-by-Step Guide
summary: Learn how to register your LLC with the Ohio Secretary of State to start your new business. We’ll walk you through each step and state-specific rules.
body_markdown:
If your LLC hires workers, review Ohio withholding, unemployment, new-hire reporting, and workers' compensation requirements. These obligations vary by the business and workforce.


- Register online through[OH|TAX eServices](https://myportal.tax.ohio.gov/tap/_/) for an Ohio employer withholding account within 15 days after withholding liability begins
- Register with the Ohio Department of Job and Family Services for unemployment compensation at jfs.ohio.gov
- Report each new hire through[Ohio's New Hire Reporting system](https://ohio.gov/business/resources/new-hire-reporting)
- Review Ohio workers' compensation requirements


Check the instructions from the Department of Taxation, the Ohio Department of Job and Family Services, Ohio New Hire Reporting, and the Bureau of Workers' Compensation. School district withholding can depend on the employee's residence and local rules, so verify it rather than assuming one example applies to every worker.
